title: What's Wrong with Buttler? The Numbers Behind the Slump
summary: JC Buttler's average has dropped from 35.8 to 15.1 in recent innings — a 21-point decline.
body:

| Period | Average | Strike Rate |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| Career | 35.8 | 146.1 |
